chunks: And by this chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Close the doors opening onto the mosque except for the door of Ali.

key_terms.الأبواب: The doors - referring to the private doors of houses that opened directly into the mosque
key_terms.الشارعة: Opening onto / leading into (the mosque from private residences)
key_terms.باب علي: The door of Ali - his personal entrance to the Prophet's Mosque

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith of Sadd al-Abwab (closing the doors) about?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) ordered that all doors leading into the mosque from surrounding houses be closed, except the door of Ali ibn Abi Talib. This is the famous hadith of Sadd al-Abwab (Closing the Doors), narrated through the same Golden Chain as the preceding tradition. It establishes the unique access Ali had to the Prophet's Mosque, paralleling his special spiritual status among the companions.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad, from `Ali (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Close the doors from the street in the Mosque except for the door of `Ali.
